conflicts: UNIT_FIRMWARE_TYPE contains JALAPENO while the active model macro selects SINGLE. This string cannot identify the physical model.

One frequency conditional uses __PRODUCT_MODEL_JALAPENO without the final double underscore. The defined model selector is __PRODUCT_MODEL_JALAPENO__. Preserve source behaviour rather than silently correcting it.
TOTAL_CHIPS_INSTALLED selects 8 slots for Jalapeno/Little Single and 16 otherwise. Do not use this allocation/loop constant as a verified fitted chip count.

protocol_limits: The Z_X command definitions do not all prove active handlers for every build.
ZMX is an LED blink command, not a firmware flashing command.
The NVRAM save/load commands change or return a persistent scratch string.
STM32 and PIC32 directories are interface placeholders; their presence does not prove working target firmware.
